Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As an HR Operations Intern, you will serve as a key support layer across the end-to-end employee lifecycle in a fast-paced hyper-growth environment. Sitting at the heart of our People team, you will handle day-to-day administrative tasks, manage internal employee support requests, and maintain high data accuracy in Workday. This 12-month internship offers hands-on operational ownership and a direct learning trajectory designed to prepare you for a full-time People Operations career.

Interviews for this position kick off in November 2026 for a 12-month, full-time role, starting on January 1, 2027.

What you'll do

  • Support the employee lifecycle: Draft HR documentation and handle daily administrative tasks across every stage of the employee journey.
  • Maintain data excellence: Maintain, update, and audit employee records in Workday with absolute accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Deliver exceptional service: Resolve first-line employee inquiries via our Jira ticketing system, meeting team SLAs with empathy and efficiency.
  • Drive process improvements: Collaborate with the broader HR Operations team on operational projects and proactive process enhancements.
  • Make an operational impact: Model a data-driven mindset and commitment to quality, directly contributing to seamless employee experiences.

Who you are

  • HR enthusiast: You possess a genuine passion for HR Operations, People processes, and managing the end-to-end employee lifecycle.
  • Detail-oriented operator: You have a keen eye for detail and take pride in maintaining data accuracy and meeting resolution standards.
  • Proactive learner: You are highly adaptable, eager to learn new tools quickly, and ready to take full ownership of daily support tasks.
  • Tech-Savvy & Adaptable: Comfortable working with modern technology and quick to learn new systems and tools (e.g., HRIS, ticketing platforms).
  • Empathetic team player: You are fluent in English with excellent communication skills and a service-oriented mindset.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We're challenging the status quo, updating the current system, and empowering our partners to build better solutions. Together, we're building the most advanced financial infrastructure, open, instant, and global, inspiring a future where anyone, anywhere can access the full potential of digital money.

We are looking for a hands-on AML Manager to help run the AML/CTF and sanctions framework of Lightspark’s Estonian regulated entity. The role will be responsible for keeping us on top of our AML obligations as the business grows, turning requirements into working processes, controls, checks and record. You will work closely with the Compliance Manager (MLRO), management, and teams across the business, giving practical compliance support that helps the company move forward without taking unnecessary risks.

As AML Manager, you will run the day-to-day side of our AML/CTF and sanctions controls. Your work will cover quality assurance of CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring and screening, oversight of first-line case handling, escalations and suspicious activity reporting, periodic assessments, AML training and the maintenance of our AML policies and procedures. You will also act as deputy to the Compliance Manager (MLRO). This is a second-line role where AML expertise and sound, well-documented judgement matter equally.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Support the Compliance Manager (MLRO) in overseeing the AML/CTF and sanctions framework as a second-line function.

  • Act as the Compliance Manager’s delegate during absences, including reviewing internal escalations and deciding on suspicious activity reports to the FIU.

  • Support and guide the first line in daily operations and oversee the quality of how tasks are resolved.

  • Provide quality assurance over CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring and screening controls, including sampling, findings, and tracking corrective actions to closure.

  • Conduct periodic analyses and assessments in line with the company’s AML/CFT and sanctions policies.

  • Contribute to the AML risk assessment and maintain AML policies and procedures, both within the review cycle and when products, processes or regulation change.

  • Organize AML training for staff in line with company policies and regulatory requirements and maintain the training records.

  • Design, improve and implement compliance policies, procedures and tools together with the management board and other departments, so that they meet regulatory requirements and fit business needs.

  • Work with Legal, Risk, Operations, Product and Finance to build AML/CTF and sanctions requirements into daily operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, risk management or due diligence, ideally at a financial institution, fintech or payment business.

  • Bachelor’s degree in law, business, finance, economics or a comparable field, or equivalent practical experience. We appreciate that some of the best talent comes from non-traditional backgrounds.

  • Deep knowledge of KYB, KYC, CDD and EDD processes, together with a solid understanding of EU and Estonian AML/CTF regulatory frameworks and supervisory practice.

  • Experience investigating cases and filing STRs.

  • Ability to meet the regulatory fit and proper requirements for a deputy MLRO role.

  • Familiarity with SumSub, ComplyAdvantage or similar AML screening tools.

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with sound, well-documented judgement on when to resolve a matter independently and when to escalate, and the independence to operate as a second-line function.

  • High attention to detail and discipline in keeping records, case files and deadlines that must withstand supervisory review.

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to explain AML requirements in practical terms to non-compliance audiences, and a strong commitment to ethical standards.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, regulated environment without compromising accuracy.

  • Fluency in Estonian and English, as the role reviews Estonian-language corporate and regulatory documentation and communicates with Estonian authorities and counterparties.

  • Experience in a multinational, high-growth company is a plus.

  • On-site 5 days, Full time, permanent

COMPENSATION

The gross monthly base salary range for this role is €3,400 – €3,990. The final offer will depend on experience and skills, and is determined using objective, gender-neutral criteria. You will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus and equity.

We welcome interest from individuals of all backgrounds and levels of experience who share our mission. descriptions.job-0rgl0qc:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Community Operations manages Stripe’s support presence across public developer and merchant communities. The team responds across channels including X, Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and app-store reviews. Because these interactions are public and one-to-many, each response can influence user trust, Stripe’s brand, and the experience of people beyond the original poster.

The team combines responsive community support with proactive signal detection. We identify recurring questions, emerging risk, product friction, documentation gaps, and opportunities to improve how Stripe supports its community.

What you’ll do

As a Community Operations Specialist, you will represent Stripe across public developer and merchant communities. You will independently assess and coordinate complex or high-visibility community cases, including situations involving influential users, executive tags, rapid amplification, privacy concerns, and incomplete information. You will guide less-experienced teammates, support incident and escalation response, surface recurring user and product signals, and contribute to defined operational-improvement projects.

You will maintain strong queue performance while building experience in higher-impact Specialist work. For novel, highly sensitive, or incident-level decisions, you will work with senior Specialists and cross-functional partners to determine the safest path forward.

Responsibilities

  • Manage community interactions across supported platforms while consistently meeting quality, productivity, and responsiveness expectations.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, ambiguous, or high-visibility community cases, including influential users, executive tags, media-adjacent attention, rapid amplification, cross-platform misinformation, and privacy or brand concerns.
  • Support teammates as they navigate complex cases by providing actionable feedback and explaining the reasoning behind recommended responses and escalation decisions.
  • Recognize potential social-media incidents or high-risk situations and engage a senior Specialist or incident lead before making a novel or material-risk public commitment.
  • Participate in incident response under senior Specialist guidance, maintaining clear ownership and communication.
  • Gather relevant facts, identify stakeholders and risks, consider response options, and recommend a safe path forward for escalated cases.
  • Use dashboards, queue reviews, social-listening reports, and basic operational data to identify patterns and support decisions; develop familiarity with basic queries where helpful.
  • Communicate clear product, user, and risk signals to cross-functional partners such as Product, Risk, Comms, and Docs.
  • Contribute to trend summaries, incident retrospectives, product-signal reports, playbooks, and internal knowledge resources.
  • Own defined components of pre-scoped improvement projects, maintaining a plan and communicating progress, dependencies, blockers, and risks.
  • Capture reusable lessons from escalations and share them through team documentation and knowledge-sharing forums.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

Minimum requirements

  • Experience in public-facing support, community operations, technical support, or a comparable user-facing operational environment.
  • Exceptional written judgment, with the ability to communicate complex or unfavorable information clearly, empathetically, and safely in public forums.
  • Sound judgment when handling ambiguity, sensitive user situations, incomplete information, and potential reputational risk, with the ability to prioritize competing cases using user impact, urgency, sensitivity, privacy risk, and public amplification.
  • Demonstrated ownership and the ability to organize work, follow through on commitments, and communicate blockers early.
  • Ability to guide or support less-experienced teammates using clear, actionable feedback and sound reasoning.
  • Comfort using dashboards, queue reviews, and basic operational data to identify patterns and support decisions; willingness to develop basic query skills where helpful.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Receptiveness to feedback and evidence of applying feedback to improve performance.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with Stripe products, payments, financial technology, APIs, or developer-facing support.
  • Experience supporting users through public or social channels.
  • Familiarity with incident response, social escalation, moderation, or brand-risk workflows.
  • Experience contributing to operational-improvement projects, root-cause investigations, or knowledge-management initiatives.
  • Familiarity with operational reporting, social-listening data, SQL, or other data-analysis tools.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

As a Program Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in driving releases and deliverables across high-impact initiatives. Operating within a Scaled Agile environment, you'll manage complex dependencies, ensuring seamless execution from planning to end-user adoption. This role requires team-building skills, as well as close collaboration with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver holistic and scalable solutions. You’ll join a high-performing Product Development team at DriveWealth, focused on building best-in-class investing infrastructure that powers global fintechs and banks. This team drives strategic initiatives from concept to launch, ensuring that our products meet the needs of both partners and end-users. We work closely with engineering, operations, and compliance to bring investing products to life in a highly regulated and fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage scrum teams from strategy through execution and delivery, guiding
    multi-phase releases across engineering, product, compliance, and operations
  • Run crisp and effective agile ceremonies, including standups, sprint planning, refinement
    sessions, and retrospective activities focused on self-improvement
  • Prepare scrum teams for quarterly PI Planning, including guiding them through the
    product intake process to create working tasks ready for development
  • Develop clear goals and measurable outcomes while maintaining adaptability in a fastpaced, Scaled Agile environment
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment on
    priorities and trade-offs across teams
  • Assist technical leads and senior developers with release planning
  • Drive operational excellence across programs and mentor squads on Agile best
    practices
  • Work within the larger PMO of the organization to raise its level of agile maturity
  • Coach teammates along the organizational journey towards agile transformation
  • Use data to evaluate progress, highlight risk, and communicate program health to both
    technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Leverage tools like Jira, Confluence, and G-Suite to manage workflows, reporting, and
    communication

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of program management experience, ideally in technical environments with
    multiple cross-functional development teams
  • Deep familiarity with Scaled Agile; CSM or similar Agile certification a plus
  • Demonstrated success leading initiatives in fintech, trading, or brokerage verticals
  • Proven ability to manage dependencies and deliver high-impact releases in
    environments with multiple competing priorities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience influencing across
    technical and business teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have, But Not Required

  • Background in brokerage, wealth management, or regulated financial services
  • Experience working with APIs and embedded finance platforms
  • Familiarity with money movement, transaction handling, or compliance workflows

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Chicago, IL - Hybrid 

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $175,000 USD – $200,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

The Chainalysis Deployment Strategy team helps public and private sector customers investigate financial crimes involving cryptocurrency. We combine technical knowledge with analytical rigor to support complex investigations and build regional capacity for blockchain analysis. In the LATAM and Caribbean region, our team works directly with customers to enable them in the fast-moving world of cryptocurrency investigations. Along the way, we make the world a safer place.

As a Deployment Strategist I, you will support cryptocurrency investigations, conduct research and data analysis, and help deliver training to customers across the LATAM and Caribbean region. You will learn to use Chainalysis tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto, and you will present findings to team members and customers. This is a growth-oriented role for someone eager to build expertise in blockchain analysis while contributing to complex financial crime investigations alongside senior team members.

 

In this role, you'll:

  • Support complex cryptocurrency investigations in collaboration with senior team members and cross-functional partners at Chainalysis

  • Conduct research and data analysis on financial crime cases involving cryptocurrencies, and document your findings in clear reports

  • Present investigative findings to team members and customers

  • Assist in reviewing the completeness of investigations and data collection methods to help determine the authenticity and relevance of evidence

  • Prepare summaries of research and analysis that highlight recommendations, follow-up leads, and potential risks to an investigation

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of workshops and training materials in English and Spanish

  • Represent the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains with customers and partners in the region

 

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • A degree in cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, forensic accounting, data analytics, finance, or a related field

  • 1-3 years of professional experience in financial crime investigations, intelligence analysis, law enforcement, compliance, or a related analytical role

  • Strong research skills, including experience with open-source intelligence and public or private databases

  • Interest in or passion for blockchain and cryptocurrency technology

  • Fluency in Spanish and English

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work both independently and as part of a team

  • Based in Mexico City or willing to relocate

Nice to have experience:

  • Familiarity with Chainalysis products (Reactor, KYT, or similar tools)

  • Working proficiency in Spanish

  • Previous experience supporting or conducting investigations related to dark web markets, counter-terrorism financing, or sanctions evasion

  • Exposure to cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, or blockchain technology in a professional setting

  • Relevant certifications such as CCFC (Chainalysis Cryptocurrency Fundamentals Certification), CDAF, CRC, CCI, CFE, or CAMS

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

Job Description

The role

This is not a testing role in the traditional sense. We're not looking for someone to catch bugs at the end of the pipeline and hand them back. We're looking for someone to own how quality happens across the entire product. As we like to put it: QA owns the testing strategy, not product quality. Product quality is shared by Product and Engineering.

Your job is to make sure the whole system is set up so that everyone can build confidence in what we ship, from the moment a feature is designed to the moment it's released. That means enabling engineers to test effectively, driving a quality mindset across teams, and building the systems and processes that support it, not just writing and running test cases.

We think about quality the way our users experience the product: as complete journeys, not as a checklist of acceptance criteria. If you read this and think "quality is someone else's problem once I've logged the bug," this role isn't for you. If you think in terms of "can the user actually achieve their goal here, and how do I make the whole team confident that they can," keep reading.

This is a senior role because it demands ownership. Not the word, the behavior: seeing what needs to happen and making it happen without being told, working across Product, Engineering, Data as a matter of course, and taking responsibility for the testing strategy of a feature end to end.

Core responsibilities

  • Own the testing strategy for the features and areas you work on. Decide how confidence gets built, which validation happens at which layer (unit, component, integration, API, golden, E2E, accessibility, performance, security, manual, exploratory), rather than defaulting everything to end-to-end testing.
  • Get involved early. Join discovery and specification reviews before development starts: clarify assumptions, surface edge cases, identify risks and dependencies, and ask the hard questions ("what happens if the API fails, if permissions are denied, if the user abandons the flow?").
  • Design test cases as part of feature development, not after it. Covering user journeys, happy paths, edge cases, error handling, recovery, and regression.
  • Enable engineers to own their part of quality. Give developers the test suites, regression packs, environments, and mock data they need to validate their own work before it reaches you, and help build a culture where they do.
  • Do the testing that matters. Structured execution of prepared cases plus mandatory exploratory testing to find what predefined cases can't predict, like usability issues, cross-feature interactions, and wrong assumptions.
  • Maintain a living view of test coverage per feature. So release decisions are based on measurable confidence rather than "the ticket is closed."
  • Continuously improve the automation strategy and the process itself. Reduce flakiness, close coverage gaps, cut repetitive manual regression, and free up time for exploratory, accessibility, security, and performance work.
  • Bring AI/LLM tools into the workflow. Use them to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and exploratory testing, and keep pushing the team's QA practices forward as new tools emerge.

 

 

Qualifications

Requirements: 

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Senior level experience in QA. You've owned quality for real features or products, made your own calls on testing strategy, and been accountable for the outcome, not just executed test plans someone else wrote.
  • A genuine ownership and proactivity mindset. You spot gaps and close them, you drive things rather than wait to be assigned, and you don't treat quality as "done" the moment a bug is filed.
  • A user- and product-first way of thinking. You test journeys and business outcomes, not just acceptance criteria, and you keep the user at the center of every decision about what and how to test.
  • Security mindset.
  • Comfort with the "shift-left" idea: quality is built throughout development, not verified at the end.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as WebdriverIO, Patrol, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or Playwright.
  • Experience writing backend tests (API, unit, database) and testing RESTful services with tools such as Postman or similar
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
  • We prioritise strong automation skills, but if your background is mostly manual, a proactive attitude, a solid technical base, and a real drive to pick up automation quickly - will still get our attention.

Nice to have: 

  • Experience in web3 or fintech, or anywhere you've tested products that handle real money. When money is on the line, there's no room for "probably fine," so it sharpens your attention to detail and your instinct for edge cases in a way that carries over well here.
  • Experience with testing across multiple layers (API, integration, golden/screenshot, performance, accessibility).
  • Experience with security testing

Additional Information

Personality Traits We Value

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
  • Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

About ComplyAdvantage

ComplyAdvantage is the financial industry’s leading source of AI-driven financial crime risk data and detection technology. Our mission is to neutralize the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, corruption, and other financial crimes.

More than 1,000 companies globally rely on us to navigate risk through the world’s only real-time database of people and companies. Backed by Goldman Sachs, Ontario Teachers’, Index Ventures, and Balderton Capital, we have raised over $100M to date. After growing our team by 40% last year, we are scaling from 500 to 600+ people - and our SDR team is the engine behind that growth.

The role

This is a people-leadership role first. As Head of Business Development for EMEA, you own the outbound business development (BDR) function across the region — hiring, developing, and leading a team of BDRs whose job is to generate qualified pipeline for our new-business sales organization.

You will set the outbound strategy, build the ramp and coaching systems that make reps successful, and create the career pathways that turn strong BDRs into future account executives. Your success is measured by the performance, retention, and progression of the team you build — and by the quality of pipeline they generate for the business.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and coach the team. Run daily coaching, call reviews, and 1:1s that raise the performance of every BDR — developing outbound craft, resilience, and commercial judgment across the group.
  • Own the hiring bar. Run a structured, competency-based interview process, and keep a bench of talent ahead of demand so the team can scale without dropping quality.
  • Design onboarding and ramp. Build and run a structured 90-day onboarding program with clear milestone gates, so new hires reach full productivity faster.
  • Build career pathways. Maintain a competency framework with assessable junior and senior behaviors, and create clear BDR-to-AE progression that helps you attract and retain ambitious reps.
  • Set the outbound strategy. Define account prioritization, ideal-customer-profile targeting, messaging, and multi-channel sequencing across EMEA, in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Own pipeline generation. Carry the team’s qualified-pipeline target, forecast opportunities into the new-business funnel, and use data to diagnose and fix what is not working.
  • Partner across the business. Work with Revenue Operations on tooling, routing, reporting, and compensation design, and align closely with Marketing on account-based programs.
  • Report on performance. Give sales leadership a clear, evidence-based view of team health, ramp, and pipeline contribution.

 

Proficient with: 

 

  • Cognism
  • Salesforce
  • Sales Nav
  • Clay
  • Building multi-outreach 
  • Insights into performing channels

What you’ll bring

People-management experience is essential. We are looking for someone with a strong track record of managing an outbound BDR or SDR team — you have hired, coached, and retained reps and led a team to target, not only carried a number yourself.

  • Team leadership. Proven experience leading and developing outbound BDRs/SDRs, with a genuine interest in growing people and a record of moving reps into more senior roles.
  • Building the function. Experience designing or scaling onboarding, ramp, coaching, and performance frameworks — not just running the ones you inherited.
  • Outbound craft. Strong command of prospecting, multi-channel sequencing, and qualification (MEDDIC or a similar framework), with the ability to teach it.
  • Data fluency. Comfortable in Salesforce and reporting tools, using metrics to manage a team, forecast pipeline, and make decisions.
  • Commercial background. Experience selling or generating pipeline in B2B SaaS; exposure to RegTech, FinTech, financial services, or compliance is an advantage.
  • The right blend. The emotional intelligence to develop people, and the operational rigor to run a team at scale across multiple markets.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or managing teams across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Familiarity with anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions, or wider financial crime compliance.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing on account-based experience (ABX) or account-based marketing (ABM) programs.

How we work

Our values shape how this team operates, and we hire for them:

  • Make a safer world. The work matters — we help stop the movement of funds that fuel serious crime.
  • Raise the bar. We hold a high standard for ourselves and each other, and we keep getting better.
  • See it, own it, drive it forward. We take ownership and follow through.
  • Win as one team. We succeed together, across functions and regions.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

About Open Standard

Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.

Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.

Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

The role

As Communications and Marketing Lead, you will craft and share the story of Open Standard with a worldwide audience: the press, policymakers, institutions evaluating Open USD, and the people who will use it every day, often without knowing its name. In the emerging era of digital money, breakthrough companies will be judged not only by their products but by their ability to clearly explain them. You will own this responsibility, working closely with our CEO on major announcements, public appearances, and the overarching narrative that connects it all.

This is a unique opportunity to establish the public voice of a company at the center of a generational transformation in finance and to build the communications and marketing function as Open Standard scales.

What you'll do

  • Own and maintain a unified company narrative across all communications, from press releases and regulatory filings to partner announcements.

  • Lead communications strategy and execution for launches, including products, blockchain integrations, and partnerships, across a dynamic calendar with simultaneous external stakeholders.

  • Partner with the communications teams of our leading partners and distributors; empower them to accurately and effectively represent Open Standard.

  • Advise the CEO on all aspects of positioning, media interviews, public speaking, and thought leadership. Prepare for tough questions as well as friendly ones.

  • Cultivate relationships with business, financial, technology, and trade press—becoming the go-to resource for journalists covering this industry.

  • Collaborate with the General Counsel on sensitive and regulatory-facing communications, determining what to say, what not to say, and how to address complex questions.

  • Develop and lead the content and social strategy across owned, earned, and executive channels, running point until the team expands.

  • Manage agency relationships for additional capacity and reach, while retaining ownership of Open Standard’s story and message.

You may be a good fit if you

  • 5-15 years of experience in communications and marketing for fintech, payments, financial services, crypto infrastructure, or regulated technology.

  • Proven track record shaping the narrative of technically complex products for customers, partners, policymakers, and journalists.

  • Direct experience advising a CEO and leading major announcements, including those that require crisis communication.

  • Experienced in joint communications efforts with legal and policy teams, especially around regulated or contested issues.

  • Capable of setting strategic direction and executing hands-on, knowing when each is appropriate.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Helped build a new infrastructure category from the communications side.

  • Led communications for businesses with numerous partners making coordinated announcements (platform, marketplace, network).

  • Collaborated with policy or government relations teams on issues of financial regulation.

Logistics

  • Location: San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in-office and remote days

Come work with us

Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.
